# Sequence Diagrams

Birnio's runtime flows. Participants are real crates/modules. The M1 target
("First Request Execution") is the first flow below.

## Send a request and render the response (M1)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant UI as birnio-ui-gtk (request_editor)
    participant Core as birnio-core
    participant Exec as birnio-http (ReqwestExecutor)
    participant Net as Remote server
    participant RV as birnio-ui-gtk (response_viewer)

    User->>UI: edits method/URL/headers/body and clicks Send
    UI->>Core: Request::new(name, method, url)
    Core-->>UI: CoreResult<Request> (validates URL)
    UI->>Exec: execute(&request)
    Exec->>Exec: request_builder::build(client, request)
    Exec->>Net: HTTP request (reqwest)
    Net-->>Exec: HTTP response
    Exec->>Exec: response_parser::parse(resp, elapsed)
    Exec-->>UI: HttpResult<Response>
    UI->>RV: Display(Response)
    RV-->>User: status, headers, body, timing
```

Errors: invalid URL → `CoreError::InvalidUrl` (the UI shows a validation error and
does not call `execute`); build failure → `HttpError::RequestBuild`; network
failure → `HttpError::Reqwest`. Both are rendered in the response_viewer as an
error state.

## Persist and reload a collection (current: SQLite)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant UI as birnio-ui-gtk (collections)
    participant Repo as birnio-storage (repositories::collections)
    participant DB as SQLite (DbPool)

    User->>UI: saves a collection
    UI->>Repo: upsert(&pool, &collection)
    Repo->>Repo: CollectionRecord::from_domain (serialize nodes_json)
    Repo->>DB: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE
    DB-->>Repo: Ok
    Repo-->>UI: StorageResult<()>

    User->>UI: opens the app
    UI->>Repo: list(&pool)
    Repo->>DB: SELECT ... ORDER BY name
    DB-->>Repo: rows
    Repo->>Repo: into_domain (deserialize)
    Repo-->>UI: Vec<Collection>
```

> When HAR persistence (M2/M3) replaces SQLite, the `DB` participant becomes
> `HAR workspace (files)` and the writer becomes atomic (#19). Update this then.
